notes: NSW trust sources reviewed in hardhat-ledger on 15 August 2026. Jurisdiction, current instruments and conflicts must be rechecked at use time.

sources.title: Building and Construction Industry Security of Payment Act 1999 (NSW)
sources.fact: Section 12A provides the NSW retention-money trust head power; coverage and action conclusions remain with a qualified human.

sources.title: Building and Construction Industry Security of Payment Regulation 2020 (NSW)
sources.fact: Part 2 controls the current NSW trust trigger, account, deposit, withdrawal, notice and record requirements.

sources.title: Queensland retention trust account duties, compilation from 28 May 2026
sources.fact: Sections 34 and 35 distinguish first withholding and later coverage. Sections 34B, 40 and 40A govern separate notices; section 51 requires immediate shortfall deposits. Sections 34A, 34C and 37A preserve authorised account transfer.

sources.title: AASB 15, December 2022 compilation, paragraphs 60 to 63
sources.fact: For reporting periods beginning on or after 1 January 2023 but before 1 July 2026, paragraph 62(c) requires both a non-financing reason and proportionality. Paragraphs 60 and 61 govern financing assessment; paragraph 63 has a separate one-year practical expedient. Later periods were not verified.
